text: Stefano comes to a sleepy village in the Valli di Comacchio to restore a fresco of Saint Sebastian's martyrdom on [the rotting wall of the local church|images|buildings and public places]. He lodges in the house of the long-dead painter Legnani's two sisters, falls for the new schoolteacher Francesca, and learns that the artist [tortured people to death to paint them|threat|people who kill]. As villagers warn him off and his employer is murdered, Stefano suspects someone [wants the painter's secret kept buried|wants|keeping crimes hidden].
